source: Appendix 1 ten contextual profiles; Appendix 2 six adaptable input profiles. Profiles suggest extraction and questions; they are never adopted project requirements.

packs.title: Drawing sets
guidance: Retain sheet indexes, legends, revisions, keyed notes and schedule links.
Inspection of selected sheets is never whole-set review.

packs.title: Architecture
guidance: Distinguish rooms, openings, finishes, demolition/retention and new work.
A nominal door width is no accessibility verdict.

packs.title: Structure
guidance: Preserve criteria, loads with units, delegated scope and inspection requirements.
Never infer spare capacity or size members.

packs.title: Mechanical and controls
guidance: Link equipment, sequences, points and furnish/install/connect/program/TAB/training responsibilities.
Missing sequences remain missing; never invent points.

packs.title: Electrical
guidance: Separate demolition and new work, fixture types, controls, circuits, temporary power and outage conditions.
Ask 'Which fixture types and quantities, and which controls, are included?'
Panel slots or nameplates do not establish spare capacity; no inferred counts or connections.

packs.title: Plumbing
guidance: Separate symptom, diagnostic visit and confirmed repair.
Ask 'Is this diagnosis only, or which confirmed repair and restoration does it include?'
A wet cabinet proves neither a burst pipe nor a compatible replacement.

packs.title: Fire and life safety
guidance: Separate design allocation, interfaces, preliminary tests, witnesses and acceptance.
Never invent adopted code editions, AHJ approval or adequacy.

packs.title: Civil and site
guidance: Preserve datum, units, surveyed extent and utility evidence levels.
A local exposure proves no continuous underground route or excavation safety.

packs.title: Specifications and procurement
guidance: Separate work results, contract packages, quote coverage and assignments.
Track alternates, allowances and replacements; keep conflicting identifiers as conflicts.

packs.title: Roofing
guidance: Priced work needs roofer-selected repair or replacement scope, surface area (not footprint), pitch, removal layers, accessories, access and disposal.
Ask 'What area/unit and removal layers does the price cover?'
Hidden decking condition stays unknown.

packs.title: HVAC
guidance: Capture the comfort request, unit identifiers, technician findings and option.
Existing capacity is not required replacement size; ask for the selection basis.

packs.title: Landscaping
guidance: Ask 'Is the area measured or estimated, and what depth applies?'
Recurring maintenance needs explicit frequency, season, billing and cancellation terms.

packs.title: General contracting and remodeling
guidance: Organize rooms and packages; clarify who furnishes and who installs.
Ask 'Who supplies the countertop, and is substrate repair included?'
